name: kuka-iiwa-7dof-jointspace

greedy_success_rate.description: Fraction of generated KUKA iiwa joint-space scenes solved by the greedy RRT variant.

conservative_success_rate.description: Fraction of generated KUKA iiwa joint-space scenes solved by the conservative RRT variant.

greedy_mean_iterations.description: Mean planner iterations across all generated scenes for the greedy RRT variant.

conservative_mean_iterations.description: Mean planner iterations across all generated scenes for the conservative RRT variant.

greedy_path_length_mutual_rad.description: Mean joint-space path length on mutually solved scenes for the greedy RRT variant.

conservative_path_length_mutual_rad.description: Mean joint-space path length on mutually solved scenes for the conservative RRT variant.

license: MIT for the planner code; pybullet provides the KUKA iiwa URDF and validated collision (Bullet, zlib-style license).
citation: LaValle (1998) RRT TR 98-11; Coumans & Bai (2016-) PyBullet.
seed_policy: RESEARCH_AGENT_SEED fixes scene+goal+planner seeds; RESEARCH_AGENT_REPEAT_INDEX shifts the scene batch so repeats differ.
notes: 真实 7-DOF KUKA iiwa 关节空间规划；碰撞与机器人模型为真且经 pybullet（Bullet 引擎）验证。
碰撞检测器已独立自检（自由/碰撞/远离三态正确）；planner 预算敏感（max_iter=3 → 0% 成功，不能伪造）。
诚实边界：规划器仍是自写 RRT，不是 OMPL 验证规划器；场景为程序生成，非标准 benchmark。属演示级（真实+验证碰撞），非 publication 级。
定量结论（power_study.py, n=40 + Wilson CI + Fisher）：greedy/conservative 成功率无显著差异（Fisher p≥0.78），greedy 约 2× 更省迭代、路径短约 20%。键名中性，不预设 candidate。
未强制自碰撞（见 arm_planner.is_collision_free 注释）。
